'''H'nemthe''' was the [[Language/Legends|language]] spoken by the [[H'nemthe (species)/Legends|H'nemthe]] of the planet [[H'nemthe/Legends|H'nemthe]].<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" />

It was mainly formed by squeals and squeaks. Many other [[Species/Legends|species]] found it irritating. Because of this, H'nemthes usually spoke [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]].<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" />

On written form, the language used a wispy contiguous line, so that letters strung together forming words.<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" />
